title: ¿Qué te dijo?
setting: Emma quiere saber qué te contó por teléfono una amiga de España

says.t: Who was on the phone? You look excited!

options.t: My friend from Spain. She told me some great news.
options.es: Mi amiga de España. Me ha contado una noticia estupenda.

options.t: My friend from Spain. She said me some great news.
options.es: (Mi amiga de España. Me ha dicho una noticia estupenda.)
options.feedback: Con persona (me), el verbo es tell: She told me.

says.t: I'm all ears! What did she say?

options.t: She said she was going to be a grandmother!
She told that she was going to be a grandmother!
options.feedback: Tell necesita persona. Sin persona: She said that…

says.t: How lovely! Is her daughter pregnant?

options.t: Yes! She said the baby was due in March.
options.es: ¡Sí! Dijo que salía de cuentas en marzo.

options.feedback: ¡Ojo! Embarrassed es «con vergüenza». Embarazada es pregnant.

says.t: Did she ask about your trip?

options.t: Yes. She asked me if I was speaking English.
options.es: Sí. Me preguntó si hablaba inglés.

options.t: Yes. She asked me if was I speaking English.
options.feedback: En estilo indirecto, orden normal: if I was speaking.

says.t: And what did you tell her?

options.t: I told her I spoke English every day!
options.es: ¡Le dije que hablaba inglés todos los días!

options.t: I told her I speak English every day!
options.es: ¡Le dije que hablo inglés todos los días!
options.feedback: Muy bien también: si sigue siendo verdad, puedes dejar el presente.

says.t: Ha ha! Did she believe you?

options.t: Not really! She asked me to send her a video.
options.es: ¡No mucho! Me pidió que le mandara un vídeo.

options.t: Not really! She asked me send her a video.
options.es: (¡No mucho! Me pidió mandar un vídeo.)
options.feedback: Pedir que alguien haga algo: asked me to + verbo.
